entities.name: PMID:25073010
observations: Chen et al., Journal of Hepatology (2014), reported LXRα/NR1H3-mediated hepatocyte-like cell differentiation via reciprocal regulation of HNF4α.

entities.name: NR1H3
observations: NR1H3 encodes LXRα; expression increased during HepaRG hepatogenesis and stem-cell differentiation in the cited study.

entities.name: HNF4A
observations: HNF4α was reported as part of the reciprocal regulatory network through which NR1H3 accelerates hepatic differentiation.

entities.name: LXRα hepatic maturation
observations: In human HepaRG cells, NR1H3 overexpression promoted hepatic maturation, with increased CYP activity, urea and albumin secretion, hepatic transcripts, and glycogen storage; authors concluded differentiation accelerated through an HNF4α-dependent reciprocal network.
